Meetily uses OpenAI's open-source Whisper model, or NVIDIA Parakeet when speed matters more, and runs it entirely on your local device.

children.q: What is the best AI transcription software?
children.a: For users who prioritize privacy, Meetily is a strong choice. It uses OpenAI's open-source Whisper model (or NVIDIA Parakeet) and runs it on your local device. Cloud services like Otter.ai or Rev process audio on their servers; with Meetily, your audio never leaves your computer. It supports 99+ languages, real-time transcription, and works offline. Community Edition is free.

children.q: Is there free AI transcription software?
children.a: Yes, Meetily Community Edition is free AI transcription software with no usage limits. Cloud-based alternatives often limit free users to a few hours per month; Community Edition does not. It runs locally on your device, requires no account, and includes AI summaries. Speaker diarization (who said what) is part of Meetily Pro.

Meetily uses Whisper AI, which delivers high accuracy for most languages and accents. Since processing happens locally, you can use higher-quality models without worrying about upload speeds. Clear audio with minimal background noise produces the best results.

Yes, Meetily works completely offline after initial installation. The AI models run locally on your device, so no internet connection is required during transcription. This makes it a good fit for sensitive environments, locations with poor connectivity, or air-gapped systems. Once the model is downloaded, transcription needs no connection.

children.q: Is AI transcription private and secure?
children.a: With cloud-based AI transcription, your audio is uploaded to external servers for processing, creating privacy risks. Meetily is different - all transcription happens locally on your device, and your audio is never uploaded. Summaries are your choice: a local model keeps the transcript on your computer, while your own API key sends the transcript text to that provider. The Community Edition is open source, so you can check how it handles data yourself.

children.q: What languages does AI transcription support?
children.a: Meetily supports transcription in over 99 languages through Whisper AI. This includes major languages like English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, and Portuguese, plus many regional languages. It can also detect languages automatically and handle multilingual content.

children.q: Can I transcribe audio files with AI?
children.a: Yes, Meetily can transcribe pre-recorded audio files in addition to live audio. Simply import your MP3, WAV, M4A, or other audio files and Meetily will transcribe them locally. This is useful for podcasts, recorded interviews, lectures, or any audio content you need converted to text.

children.q: How does AI transcription compare to human transcription?
children.a: AI transcription with Meetily is much faster and cheaper than human transcription. A human transcriptionist usually needs several hours per hour of audio and charges by the minute, while Meetily transcribes in real time, and the Community Edition is free. Accuracy is high for clear audio. Human transcription may still be preferred for heavily accented speech or poor audio quality.
